Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.base

Interface PreCommandExecution

All Known Implementing Classes:
SelectionPreCondition
public interface PreCommandExecution
A basic interface for providing safe guards before a command is executed. This is the bare bones implementation of simply checking if it's true and attaching listeners. Concrete implementations need to make their own clean-up or otherwise logging logic.

An example would be SelectionPreCondition, where it allows commands to require that a selection is made before the command can execute. And if on run a selection was not made, it queries the user for a selection.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

    • execute

      default boolean execute(SafeJLabel logLabel)
      Executes the pre-command condition check. If the condition is not met, it displays a message to the user and attaches the pass listener to the appropriate event emitter, waiting for the condition to be met. If the condition is met, it immediately triggers the pass listener.
      Parameters:
      logLabel - The SafeJLabel to display messages to the user.
      Returns:
      true if the condition was met immediately, false otherwise.
